name: Xiomara Rosales
source:
Pilot of the Coquette Dragoon.

A friendly rabbit trying her best. Tries to be cute and positive, but is riddled with anxiety. The newest addition to the squadron, having only just became a pilot for the Lilac. Wants to be able to make friends and find a place of acceptance. Smokes cigarettes despite her image. Baby of the team.

Sign: Pisces
Favourite Food: Pasta.
Hobbies: Still trying to figure them out.
Likes: Approval, Moms.
Dislikes: Older men, Being talked down to.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
